data.name: They Rise
data.detailed_description:
Synopsis

Your world has become a living nightmare. A mysterious, violent disease has torn the country apart. You are one of the few still fighting to survive, pushing towards the border where hope may still remain.

This is a first-person, narrative-driven survival horror experience set in a stylized, rapidly decaying world. Explore desolate spaces, work with survivors, and face bleak horrors as you make your way forward. Every encounter matters, and every decision comes with risk.

Gameplay

Manage your inventory, choose your fights carefully, and adapt to each situation. Use melee weapons and firearms as a last resort. Along the way, you’ll meet others, each interaction shaping your journey in a grim world.

Key Features

  • First-Person Survival Horror

  • Meaningful Character Interactions

  • Inventory Management

  • Exploration

  • Melee & Ranged Combat

  • Multiple Endings

  • Stylized, Atmospheric World

data.short_description: A Living nightmare, the world you know has been thrust into ruin and chaos at the hands of a violent disease. Run, hide, and fight your way to the border where hope may still remain but always remember. When they rise… will you be able to keep your humanity?

content_descriptors.notes: This game has depictions of violence & gore e.g. killing, striking, corpses, severed limbs. Violence and abuse towards women is insinuated but not depicted on-screen. Alcohol & drug use is insinuated but not depicted on-screen.
